title: The Steamvault
body: The Steamvault is the working heart of Coilfang Reservoir, a warren of flooded halls beneath Serpent Lake where the naga keep great machinery running. The air hangs thick with steam and the thrum of the pumps never stops. Naga engineers, sorceresses and slavemasters drive gangs of Dreghood Broken at the work, leper gnomes tend a towering machine, and beyond a great door Warlord Kalithresh commands the vault among his distillers.

parts.body: Orders sealed by Lady Vashj command that the water drawn from the other lakes into the reservoir be doubled, and that the Cenarion druids in the region be slain on sight.
sources: zones/steamvault.txt (map 545: area 3715 only)

parts.body: If Vashj is involved, Ysiel Windsinger says, the Expedition's small victories mean nothing. The druids who came to Outland to study a marsh are arming for war with the naga.
sources: zones/steamvault.txt (map 545: area 3715 only)

title: Warlord Kalithresh
body: Warlord Kalithresh commands the Steamvault from its main chambers, a naga war leader among the great distillers, his warriors and sorceresses about him. He despises surface dwellers, and swears to those who reach him that the work here will not be compromised. Watcher Jhang heard his name spoken by naga passing through the reservoir's tunnels, and wants him stopped.

parts.body: He died crying out for her Excellency, for Vashj. To the Cenarion Expedition he was its biggest enemy in the region.
sources: creature_template 17798 (display 20235 Naga_Male); fixed spawn 142045, map 545 only
